context_contract.runtime_locator: within the task component's pinned public source, find the unique non-locale Lua file containing the whitespace-normalized English source string
context_contract.surface_locator: parse the fixed_source relative path from the frozen bounded-context metadata, then find the unique whitespace-normalized English source occurrence in that file
context_contract.block: nearest enclosing Lua newEffect, newTalent, newChat or newEntity brace-balanced block; deterministic centered file window only when no supported constructor exists
context_contract.missing_policy: any missing or non-unique source file or enclosing block is CONTEXT_MISSING and fails preflight before inference; multiple literal occurrences are allowed only when every occurrence resolves to the same block
context_contract.visible_content: raw sanitized Lua code only; no paths, symbol labels, expected claims, mutation metadata or human conclusions

runtime_selection_notes.mutation_screen: Before any reviewer output, require each injected runtime atom to be absent or ambiguous in source alone and directly decidable from the mechanically visible B-arm Lua block.

replacements.reason: The original two-source atom was already explicit in the English source, so it could not identify source-context gain.
The original other-effect exception depended on engine behavior outside the mechanically visible B-arm block.

runtime_selection_notes.control_rank: After pre-inference source verification excludes any contaminated baseline, sort remaining non-mutation candidates by SHA-256(seed + NUL + 'control' + NUL + task_id + NUL + original_revision_key); first 12 controls and any remainder is an ordered reserve.
